'''Hallis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[War on Iokath]]. In [[3630 BBY]] she accompanied the forces brought by the Republic [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] to [[Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Hallis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a rare champion commander on Iokath, found only in the PVP instance.
